regime_context: Hong Kong thematic leadership is narrow and concentrated: only 4 of 17 themes clear the absolute-trend eligibility gate, and Banks (H + HK) leads Diversified Miners by a thin 0.103 margin with rotation breadth at 0.24 ("narrow"). Gate_helps is true on this market's history, so trend discipline does reduce drawdown here; but the leader's own hurst_tag is mean-revert and breadth is just 0.538, so leadership cohesion is middling. Momentum rank is a focus lens, not alpha.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Diversified Miners clears the eligibility gate (currently eligible=false, durability_bar 0.26) and sustains score near Banks; only if Miners flips to eligible=true while Banks mean-reverts would a confirmed handoff deserve attention. This is a watch, not a call.
